font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526477

g.text: Symbols: rectangle = external entity; circle = process; parallel lines = data store; labeled arrow = data flow.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526477

g.text: E1 and D1 are repeated for clarity (the same user and store). A diagonal corner marks repeated external entities.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526477

g.text: D1 combines private temporary image files on disk with process-local session metadata (token hash, dimensions and expiry).

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526477

g.text: Edit / export settings include adjustments, RGB curves, crop and the optional enhancement recipe and strength.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526477

g.text: Requests to 3.0–6.0 carry an image ID and bearer token. Each process may return validation or operation errors to E1.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526477

g.text: Preset selection and reset update browser-held settings; settings accompany render requests. Edits are not stored in PostgreSQL.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526477

g.text: Session expiry and application cleanup also remove D1 data; these internal lifecycle activities are omitted from the user flows.
